title: Giving Advice
description: Ask for and give practical work or study advice.
objectives: Ask for and give practical work or study advice.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to ask for and give practical work or study advice. The central language is should/shouldn't plus base verb. It belongs to the practical context of work, study & responsibilities. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A2, connect the main message to a time, reason, contrast, or result. Listen for context before choosing the tense or functional phrase. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.english: You should make a weekly study plan.
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the giving advice exchange.

blocks.english: You shouldn't wait until the deadline.
blocks.explanation: This giving advice model adds a different detail or response.

blocks.english: What do you need to do?
blocks.explanation: Use this question or response to keep the giving advice exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “You should make a weekly study plan.” and “You shouldn't wait until the deadline.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled. Compare the time and viewpoint in each model, and use a linker when two ideas need a clear relationship. Avoid adding advanced forms when the lesson pattern already communicates the message accurately.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: should/shouldn't plus base verb.
